title: Horizon rail: Breadcrumbs + Pulse workspace switcher
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Redesign the left rail and top breadcrumb to better surface context for multi-tenant teams (workspaces, projects, routes) and to introduce a compact ‘Pulse’ workspace switcher for fast switching without losing route context. This ticket captures the IA and visual prototype work, reviews with PM/Engineering, accessibility checks, and handoff assets for implementation.

Problem statement: Current console navigation mixes global actions (Create, Search, Billing) with route-level context (model details, rollout configs, dashboard filters). Users lose place when switching workspaces which causes confusion in rollouts and cost dashboards.

Design goals and constraints:
- Make workspace switching low-friction and reversible: allow switching without losing route state where sensible (e.g., dashboards, rollouts).
- Surface cost and rollout affordances at route level: show token spend and active rollouts in the rail compactly.
- Preserve single-column narrow rail for small screens and support compact mode for power users.
- Accessibility: keyboard-first focus, ARIA labels for switcher and breadcrumb popovers, 4.5:1 contrast for critical elements.
- Engineering constraints: support existing route IDs, preserve deep-linking semantics, minimal changes to current routing props.

Scope of work in this ticket:
- IA map for rail and breadcrumb interactions (desktop + tablet).
- High-fidelity Figma prototype for Pulse switcher flows (open, quick-switch, switch-and-return).
- Visual tokens for compact state, focus styles, and rollout badges.
- Review notes and decisions from cross-functional reviews and an implementation-ready spec for the frontend team.

Out of scope: complete redesign of top nav search UX and billing flow changes (separate tickets).
acceptance_criteria: IA diagram reviewed and annotated with routing implications and handed to frontend (link in attachments)
Figma prototype demonstrates: open Pulse, keyboard navigation, switch with preserved route state for dashboards, and switch without preserved state for project-scoped pages
PM sign-off on prescribed route-preservation matrix (list of pages that preserve vs reset state)
Engineering feasibility validated: minimal router prop changes and a migration plan for existing deep links
Automated accessibility checklist passed in design review (keyboard-only flows and ARIA labeling documented)
Handoff includes component specs (collapse behavior, active badge, rollout pill) and tokens for compact mode
tasks: Build IA artifact: left-rail decision map with route preservation matrix
Design Figma prototype: Pulse switcher + breadcrumb micro-interactions
Create visual token sheet for compact mode and rollout/cost badges
Run design review with PM and Eng: capture trade-offs and finalize matrix
Produce implementation spec and sample component CSS/vars for frontend handoff
Accessibility pass: keyboard nav and ARIA labels documented
